SET RutaCsv TO $'''C:\\Users\\Chino\\Downloads\\proyecto_solicitudes_estudiantes\\proyecto_solicitudes\\datos\\solicitudes_base.csv'''
SET RutaResultados TO $'''C:\\Users\\Chino\\Downloads\\proyecto_solicitudes_estudiantes\\proyecto_solicitudes\\evidencias\\resultados_lote_01.csv'''
IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: RutaResultados) THEN
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Message: $'''Elige otro archivo de resultados''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed4
    EXIT Code: 0
END
File.ReadFromCSVFile.ReadCSVWithCustomSeparator CSVFile: RutaCsv Encoding: File.CSVEncoding.UTF8 TrimFields: False FirstLineContainsColumnNames: True CustomColumnsSeparator: $''',''' CSVTable=> Solicitudes
File.WriteText File: RutaResultados TextToWrite: $'''id_solicitud,folio,estado''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Overwrite Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
LOOP FOREACH SolicitudActual IN Solicitudes
    SET IdSolicitud TO SolicitudActual['id_solicitud']
    SET Solicitante TO SolicitudActual['solicitante']
    SET Area TO SolicitudActual['area']
    SET Tipo TO SolicitudActual['tipo']
    SET Descripcion TO SolicitudActual['descripcion']
    UIAutomation.FocusWindow.Focus Window: appmask['Campos']['Ventana_Solicitudes']
    UIAutomation.Click.Click Element: appmask['Campos']['Boton_Nueva'] ClickType: UIAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MousePositionRelativeToElement: UIAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Campos']['Campo_Identificador'] Text: IdSolicitud Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
    UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Campos']['Campo_Solicitante'] Text: Solicitante Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
    UIAutomation.SetDropDownListValueInWindow.SetDropDownListValueByName DropDownList: appmask['Campos']['Lista_Area'] OptionsNames: Area UseRegularExpressions: False
    UIAutomation.SetDropDownListValueInWindow.SetDropDownListValueByName DropDownList: appmask['Campos']['Lista_Tipo'] OptionsNames: Tipo UseRegularExpressions: False
    UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Campos']['Campo_Descripcion'] Text: Descripcion Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
    UIAutomation.Click.Click Element: appmask['Campos']['Boton_Registrar'] ClickType: UIAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MousePositionRelativeToElement: UIAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindowContent.WindowToContainElement Element: appmask['Campos']['Ventana_Confirmar']) FOR 10
    UIAutomation.Click.Click Element: appmask['Campos']['Boton_Confirmar'] ClickType: UIAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MousePositionRelativeToElement: UIAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindowContent.WindowToContainElement Element: appmask['Campos']['Ventana_Completado']) FOR 10
    UIAutomation.GetElementDetails Element: appmask['Campos']['Campo_FolioDialogo'] AttributeName: $'''Own Text''' BringToFront: True AttributeValue=> FolioActual
    UIAutomation.Click.Click Element: appmask['Campos']['Boton_AceptarResultado'] ClickType: UIAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MousePositionRelativeToElement: UIAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    UIAutomation.GetElementDetails Element: appmask['Campos']['Campo_UltimoFolio'] AttributeName: $'''Own Text''' BringToFront: True AttributeValue=> FolioEnPantalla
    IF IsEmpty(FolioActual) THEN
        Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Message: $'''No se pudo leer el folio''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed
        EXIT Code: 0
    END
    IF NotStartsWith(FolioActual, $'''FOL-''', False) THEN
        Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Message: $'''El valor leído no parece un folio''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed2
        EXIT Code: 0
    END
    IF FolioActual <> FolioEnPantalla THEN
        Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Message: $'''Los folios no coinciden''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed3
        EXIT Code: 0
    END
    File.WriteText File: RutaResultados TextToWrite: $'''%IdSolicitud%,%FolioActual%,REGISTRADA''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
END
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Message: $'''Lote terminado. Revisa %RutaResultados%''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed5
